title: Brief
description: The approved creative brief for one job. Written by the brief stage; stored in job.outputs.brief.data.
$comment: v2 (feat/brief) adds optional fields only; v1 records stay valid. Text/detail pairs (offer/offer_detail, cta/cta_detail, audience/audience_detail): the *_detail field is the source of truth when present, and the text field is generated from it on save. Validator check 12 confirms they agree. See docs/decisions/0004-brief-field-pairs.md.

client_version.description: Version of the client profile this brief was written against. If the profile changes later, check the brief still holds.

objective.description: What this piece must achieve, in one or two sentences.

occasion.description: Festival, launch or event this is for, if any.

audience.description: Who this piece is for. Defaults to the client's audience if not narrower.

offer.description: Price, discount or offer to show, if any.

cta.description: Call to action, e.g. 'DM to book', 'Visit this Sunday'.

changes_from_master.description: v2: what this platform variant changes from the master brief (length, aspect ratio, hook timing, caption length, CTA button). Required by the self-check when aspect_ratio or duration_sec differ from the master. Message, offer, price and CTA never change.

mandatories.description: Must appear: logo, address, phone line, disclaimer, hashtags, etc.

credit_budget.description: Generation credits budgeted for this job.

success_measure.description: How we'll judge it worked, e.g. 'DMs during festival week'.

assumptions.description: Anything we filled in without the client confirming it.

status.description: draft = being written; awaiting-team / awaiting-client = blocking questions are out; ready = self-check passed, waiting at the admin gate; approved = gate approved (by the admin, or auto-approved under config.brief_auto_approve_repeat).

changelog.description: One line per brief version, newest last. Each entry says what changed and why, and which later stages must be reviewed.

job_kind.description: Kind of job; decides which fields are blocking essentials (skills/pre-production/brief/references/essentials.md). general = none of the others.

objective_label.description: Marketing label for `objective` (which stays in plain words): calls or WhatsApp → leads; shop visits → footfall; orders → sales; remember the brand → awareness; followers → growth; event attendance → event.

audience_detail.description: Structured audience. Source of truth for `audience` when present; `audience` is generated from it and must contain `who`.

proof_points.description: Facts that back the message. Each needs a source; nothing invented (references/proof-and-claims.md).

ref.description: Where exactly: profile field, insight finding id, client message date, job id.

offer_detail.description: Structured offer. Source of truth for `offer` when present; `offer` is generated from it and must show the same price.

text.description: The offer in plain words, e.g. 'Curtain + sofa cleaning 20% off'.

price.description: Exact price in rupees, if the offer shows one.

profile_match.description: How the price compares with the client's saved price_points: matches; differs (flagged in open_questions until confirmed); not-in-profile (new price, confirmed by the client or flagged).

profile_price.description: The saved price it was compared with, if any.

cta_detail.description: Structured call to action. Source of truth for `cta` when present; `cta` is generated from it, contains `action` and names the same channel.

action.description: What the viewer does, in the video's language, e.g. 'WhatsApp karo'.

target.description: Label only, never a phone number, e.g. 'shop WhatsApp on end card', 'Vijay Nagar branch'.

creative_format.description: Video or poster format, chosen with references/objective-to-format.md.

platforms.description: Every platform in deliverables, listed once.

aspect_ratio.description: Master aspect ratio. A deliverable that differs must say so in changes_from_master.

duration_sec.description: Master length for video. A deliverable that differs must say so in changes_from_master.

writing_script.description: How on-screen text and captions are written: roman-hinglish (Hindi or Hinglish in Roman letters), devanagari, english. Named writing_script because `script` is the script stage's contract field.

research.description: What the brief took from the research stage (job.outputs.research). No research output → status skipped, skip_reason 'no research output on this job'. Mapping: skills/pre-production/brief/references/research-input.md.

skip_reason.description: Why research was skipped (required when status is skipped).

no_angle_reason.description: Why no research angle was used although research exists.

track_suggestion.description: Advisory only; the producer and admin decide the track.

confidence.description: Per brief field: confirmed (said or approved by a person in this job, or confirmed in the client profile) or guessed (inferred), plus where it came from.

basis.description: e.g. 'intake note', 'profile price_points (confirmed)', 'default for offer reels'.

client_questions.description: Questions only the client can answer, sent as one numbered WhatsApp message. Mirrored to the BriefQuestions tab for the Dashboard reminder; this list is the source of truth.

question.description: As sent, in the client's language.

guess.description: Our guess, shown with the question.

field.description: Brief field the answer fills, e.g. offer_detail.price.

answer.description: Short paraphrase of the client's answer (no phone numbers).

ready_for_production.description: True only when every self_check passed: an editor could start without asking anything.

downstream.description: Handoff for later stages: what each one needs from this brief, so they don't re-derive it. shot_sourcing is for a future stage.

first_frame.description: What must be visible in the first frame, e.g. 'price', from a learning.

keep_as_is.description: Brand names, prices, addresses: never translated.

id.description: Stable finding id from the insight, if any.
